How to keep 40+ tabs open in Chrome without melting your laptop's RAM

Most people know that Chrome tabs eat memory, but closing them loses your context. We built an instant 1-click RAM Snoozer inside TabBox that uses Chrome's native `tabs.discard` API.

It freezes background memory consumption while preserving your tab position and favicons. Tested it reclaiming 1.2 GB of RAM on an M1 Mac in 1 second.

Free tool for anyone managing research or heavy project tabs: https://tabbox.dev
